title: 第149章 准备第148章 抉择
content_zh:
第149章准备
方圆决定去关那扇门之后，没有急着动身。
他把手记和那块黑色石头收好，又去井边打了一桶水，把院子里的地浇了一遍。王紫璇坐在石桌旁看着他浇地，没有问。她等他把水瓢放下，才开口。“你什么时候走？”方圆想了想。“三天后。”“三天能准备好？”“能。”方圆把水瓢放回桶里，在石凳上坐下，“我要去天机阁一趟，拿一些东西。还要去一趟极北冰原，确认封印还在。”王紫璇点了点头，“那我给你准备干粮。”
第二天一早，方圆骑马向中州城奔去。他没有去找陆长老，而是直接去了天机阁塔楼。天机阁的弟子看到他，没有拦他。他上了七楼，敲了敲陆长老房间的门——陆长老已经不住在这里了，但门还是开了。开门的是一个年轻男人，穿着一身天机阁的制服，面容清秀，眼神沉稳。“你是方圆？”“是我。”“我是周玄。陆长老的弟子。师父走之前交代过，如果你来，让我把这东西交给你。”他从怀里取出一块玉佩，递给方圆。玉佩是白色的，温润光滑，上面刻着一个“天”字。方圆接过玉佩，握在手心——和天机阁主留下的那块天命玉很像，但更小一些，灵气也更淡。“这是什么？”“师父说，这是通往那扇门的钥匙。他说你知道怎么用。”方圆把玉佩收入怀中。“陆长老在哪？”“他在城东的院子里，最近身体不太好，不怎么出门了。”方圆点了点头，转身向楼梯口走去。
从塔楼出来，他没有去城东看陆长老，直接骑马出了中州城，向北奔去。他骑得很快，风从耳边刮过。极北冰原很远，来回要半个月。他没有时间了。天机阁主说，万魔之祖的本体随时可能到来。他必须在那之前准备好。
走了五天，到了冰封峡谷。他没有停留，直接走到封印所在的地方，抓住裂缝边缘翻身跳了下去。祭坛还在，心脏还在跳，咚、咚、咚、咚。他走到石壁前，咬破手指，将血滴在石壁上，石壁缓缓打开，他弯腰钻了进去。走到那面墙前面，墙上的画还是那片混沌的虚空，虚空中站着那个模糊的人影。方圆在墙前面站了很久。他没有开口说话，墙上的虚影也没有波动。他看着那片混沌的虚空，像是在确认它还在那里，确认它还没有裂开。然后他转身，沿着通道走了出去。走到外面，天已经快黑了。风很大，雪被吹起来打在脸上。他翻身上马，向南方奔去。
回到青州城的时候，已经是第十天了。他推开院门，王紫璇正坐在石桌旁，面前放着两个包袱。一个大的，装的是干粮和水。一个小的，装的是伤药和几件厚衣服。“都准备好了。”方圆在石桌旁坐下，拿起那个大包袱掂了掂，又放下。“三天后走。”王紫璇点了点头。
三天后，天还没亮，方圆就起来了。他把两个包袱系在马上，站在院子门口最后看了一遍。枣树的叶子已经落光了，光秃秃的枝条在晨风中轻轻摇晃，像是秋天在替他数着日子。他转身走出院子，在巷子口站了片刻，没有听到门响。他没有回头，骑马向南奔去。
第149章准备
王紫璇没有送他。她站在正房门口，手扶着门框，看着院门关上的方向。她站了很久，才转身走进屋里。那碗粥还在桌上冒着热气，像是她还准备着要等的人还会回来一样。她端起那碗粥，低头喝了一口，慢吞吞地咽下去，把碗洗了，放回碗架。然后她走到院子里，蹲在枣树前面，伸手碰了一下光秃秃的枝条。枝条还活着。
方圆骑马一路向南，没有停。他没有回头，没有放慢速度。他不再去想天机阁主到底瞒了他什么，也不再想父亲当年为什么拒绝他。天机阁主给了他钥匙，告诉了他那扇门的位置。他不需要知道全部真相，只需要知道那扇门关上之后，万魔之祖的本体就过不来了。剩下的路，他自己走。
又走了几天，他到了天玄大陆的南海岸。海风吹过来，带着咸腥的味道。他在海边停了一会儿，然后翻身下马，牵着马沿着海岸线走了一段路，在一处礁石旁边停了下来。他取出那块白色的玉佩，握在手心，注入灵气。玉佩亮了起来，光芒从白色变成了金色，一闪一闪的。前方的海面开始波动，像是一块巨大的幕布被风吹了一下。海水分开，露出一条向下的石阶。方圆把马拴在礁石上，沿着石阶向下走去。石阶很长，弯弯曲曲的，两边的墙壁上刻满了符文。他走得很慢，每一步都踩实了才迈下一步。走了大约一盏茶的功夫，前方出现了一道光门。光门不大，刚好容一个人通过。光门后面的景象模糊一片，什么都看不清。方圆站在光门前面，没有立刻跨过去。他回头看了一下身后，石阶已经被黑暗吞没，看不到来路了。他转过身，迈步跨过了光门。光芒一闪，他出现在了一个陌生的地方——一片灰色的平原，没有草，没有树，没有水，只有土和石头。天空也是灰色的，没有太阳，没有云。平原的中央，有一道裂缝。裂缝不大，只有三尺长，像是被人用刀划开的一道口子。裂缝中透出黑色的光芒，像是有什么东西在裂缝后面涌动。方圆走到裂缝前面，蹲下身，伸手靠近裂缝。指尖触到裂缝边缘的时候，他感觉到了一股寒意——不是冷的寒意，是另一种寒意，像是从虚无深处渗出来的东西。他收回手，取出那块白色玉佩，放在裂缝旁边。玉佩开始发光，光芒沿着裂缝的边缘蔓延，像是要把那道口子缝起来。方圆看着那道裂缝，知道一旦它完全合上，他就再也回不去了。
他没有犹豫。他把灵气注入玉佩，白光暴涨。裂缝在光芒中慢慢收缩，越来越小，越来越细。当裂缝完全合拢的那一刻，玉佩碎成了粉末，被风吹散。那片灰色的平原消失了。他站在一片虚空中，没有天，没有地，没有方向。

Chapter 149 Preparation
After Fangyuan decided to close the door, she didn't leave in a hurry.
He put the notebook and the black stone away, went to the well to get a bucket of water, and watered the ground in the yard. Wang Zixuan sat at the stone table and watched him water the ground without asking. She waited for him to put down the water ladle before speaking. "When are you leaving?" Fangyuan thought for a while. "Three days later." "Can it be ready in three days?" "Yes." Fangyuan put the water ladle back into the bucket and sat down on the stone bench. "I'm going to Tianji Pavilion to get some things. I also want to go to the Far North Icefield to confirm that the seal is still there." Wang Zixuan nodded, "Then I'll prepare dry food for you."
Early the next morning, Fangyuan rode towards Zhongzhou City. He did not go to Elder Lu, but went directly to the Tianji Pavilion Tower. The disciples of Tianji Pavilion saw him and did not stop him. He went up to the seventh floor and knocked on the door of Elder Lu's room - Elder Lu no longer lived here, but the door was still open. The person who opened the door was a young man, wearing a Tianji Pavilion uniform, with a handsome face and steady eyes. "Are you Fangyuan?" "It's me." "I'm Zhou Xuan, a disciple of Elder Lu. Master told me before he left, if you come, let me give this to you." He took out a jade pendant from his arms and handed it to Fangyuan. The jade pendant is white, warm and smooth, with the word "天" engraved on it. Fangyuan took the jade pendant and held it in the palm of his hand - it was very similar to the piece of destiny jade left by the master of Tianji Pavilion, but smaller and less spiritual. "What is this?" "Master said, this is the key to that door. He said you know how to use it." Fang Yuan put the jade pendant into his arms. "Where is Elder Lu?" "He is in the courtyard to the east of the city. He has been in poor health recently and doesn't go out much." Fang Yuan nodded, turned and walked towards the stairs.
After coming out of the tower, he did not go to the east of the city to see Elder Lu, but rode directly out of Zhongzhou City and ran north. He rode very fast, the wind blowing from his ears. The Arctic Icefield is very far away, and it takes half a month to go back and forth. He has no time. The master of Tianji Pavilion said that the true form of the ancestor of all demons may arrive at any time. He had to be ready before then.
After walking for five days, we arrived at the frozen canyon. He didn't stop, walked directly to where the seal was, grabbed the edge of the crack, turned over and jumped. The altar is still there, the heart is still beating, thump, thump, thump, thump. He walked to the stone wall, bit his finger and dripped blood on the stone wall. The stone wall slowly opened and he bent down and got in. Walking to the wall, the painting on the wall was still the chaotic void, with the blurry figure standing in the void. Fangyuan stood in front of the wall for a long time. He didn't speak, and the shadow on the wall didn't waver. He looked at the chaotic void, as if to make sure it was still there, to make sure it hadn't cracked yet. Then he turned and walked out along the passage. When we walked outside, it was almost dark. The wind was so strong that the snow was blown up and hit my face. He got on his horse and ran towards the south.
When we returned to Qingzhou City, it was already the tenth day. He pushed open the courtyard door and saw Wang Zixuan sitting at the stone table with two bundles in front of her. A large one filled with dry food and water. A small one, containing wound medicine and some thick clothes. "Everything is ready." Fang Yuan sat down at the stone table, picked up the big bundle, weighed it, and then put it down. "Leave in three days." Wang Zixuan nodded.
Three days later, before dawn, Fangyuan got up. He tied the two bundles to his horse and stood at the door of the courtyard to look at them one last time. The leaves of the jujube tree have fallen off, and the bare branches are swaying gently in the morning breeze, as if autumn is counting the days for him. He turned around and walked out of the yard, standing at the entrance of the alley for a moment without hearing the door. He didn't look back and rode south.
Chapter 149 Preparation
Wang Zixuan did not send him off. She stood at the door of the main house, holding the door frame with her hands, looking in the direction of the courtyard door closing. She stood for a long time before turning and walking into the house. The bowl of porridge was still steaming on the table, as if she was still preparing to eat it.Those who wait will come back. She picked up the bowl of porridge, lowered her head and took a sip, swallowed it slowly, washed the bowl and put it back on the dish rack. Then she walked to the yard, squatted in front of the jujube tree, and touched the bare branches with her hand. The branches are still alive.
Fangyuan rode southward without stopping. He didn't look back, didn't slow down. He no longer thought about what the Master of Tianji Pavilion had hidden from him, nor why his father rejected him back then. The master of Tianji Pavilion gave him the key and told him the location of the door. He doesn't need to know the whole truth, he just needs to know that after the door is closed, the original form of the ancestor of all demons will not be able to get through. He walked the rest of the way by himself.
After walking for a few more days, he arrived at the south coast of Tianxuan Continent. The sea breeze blows over, carrying a salty smell. He stopped at the beach for a while, then dismounted and led the horse along the coastline for a while, stopping next to a rock. He took out the white jade pendant, held it in his hand, and injected spiritual energy into it. The jade pendant lit up, and the light turned from white to gold, flickering. The sea surface in front began to fluctuate, like a huge curtain being blown by the wind. The water parted, revealing a downward stone staircase. Fangyuan tied the horse to the rock and walked down the stone steps. The stone steps are long and winding, and the walls on both sides are covered with runes. He walked very slowly, taking each step firmly before taking the next. After walking for about a cup of tea, a light door appeared in front of me. The light door is not big, just enough for one person to pass through. The scene behind the light door was blurry and nothing could be seen clearly. Fangyuan stood in front of the light door and did not step over immediately. He looked back behind him. The stone steps had been swallowed up by darkness and he couldn't see the way forward. He turned around and stepped through the light door. In a flash of light, he appeared in a strange place - a gray plain with no grass, no trees, no water, only soil and stones. The sky is also gray, no sun, no clouds. In the center of the plain, there is a crack. The crack was not big, only three feet long, like a cut opened by someone with a knife. There was a black light coming from the crack, as if something was surging behind the crack. Fangyuan walked to the front of the crack, squatted down, and reached out to get close to the crack. When his fingertips touched the edge of the crack, he felt a chill - not a cold chill, but another kind of chill, like something seeping out from the depths of nothingness. He retracted his hand, took out the white jade pendant, and placed it next to the crack. The jade pendant began to glow, and the light spread along the edge of the crack, as if it was trying to seal the hole. Fang Yuan looked at the crack, knowing that once it closed completely, he would never be able to go back.
He didn't hesitate. He injected spiritual energy into the jade pendant, and the white light surged. The cracks slowly shrank in the light, getting smaller and thinner. When the cracks completely closed, the jade pendant shattered into powder and was blown away by the wind. The gray plain disappeared. He stood in a void, with no sky, no earth, and no direction.
